noun_definition: Web refers to the online chat interface where users can copy and paste text, including line breaks, without losing formatting.
Chat refers to the interface where users can send and receive messages, which in this context is experiencing issues with preserving line breaks when text is copied and pasted into it.
Line break refers to the visual separation between lines of text that is lost when copying and pasting text from one context to another in the chat application.

Special copy or paste scenario refers to the process of copying text that includes line breaks from one location and pasting it into a chat, where the expectation is that the line breaks will be preserved.
